review_method: Manual assistant visual review of crops-000.jpg, frames-000.jpg and frames-012.jpg covering all 23 crops and 13 frames; native/011.png also inspected for tiny unmatched regions.
notes: Three red and ten blue latex balloons, including small/dark examples, are identifiable from crops and full-frame context. Eight background crops show shirt/arm/head, roof or pavement. Exclude 20 and 21: tiny 4x5 and 11x9 background proposals offer little interpretable training content. No automatic negative labels.
limitations: Outdoor daylight scenes from two filename dates; related views of the same objects. Does not establish arena generalization. IMG names belong to this separately hash-pinned Astek archive, not the reserved EngDes2 family. Admission still requires source/crop integrity validation in the dataset builder.
